claim_ceiling: exact T1 C1/C2/C3 on two tagged ten-state factors; conditional finite handoff of a surrogate integrated package if new checks succeed; no full P05 C-package or T17-I

carrier.tag_rule: tag × exact T1 kernel; same rows, disjoint tags
carrier.full_temporal_carrier: T1 factor plus typed event/path, budget and route-register context; C1 audit is explicitly only on exact T1 factor

new_field_rules.source_histories: finite positive-support paths of canonical T1 P, horizon two, with listed starts; retain full past as history data
new_field_rules.target_histories: apply tag map pointwise to source histories; target past provenance remains visible only internally
new_field_rules.public_channels: current public position f and deadline/action availability on K; expanded control additionally reads M
new_field_rules.future_interface: PredictiveNow=M, event/path order, tick parity, cumulative progress, endogenous record counter, route residue, maintenance state and owner
new_field_rules.c6_code: q=(M,unfolded event count,current tick parity,current route register,current maintenance state,owner) from raw fields; no full T1 state identity or past label; progress and record counters are derived from event count in the funded regime
new_field_rules.event_order: index along realized path, not a strictly increasing state-valued order on recurrent K
new_field_rules.tick_progress_record: one successful funded atomic transition contributes one tick, one progress unit, one target-owned record entry; derived from realized event count
new_field_rules.ledger_price: one indivisible maintenance token is consumed per canonical action; target recharge supplies one token per action when funded; initial budget is one token
new_field_rules.funded_transition: if token and target recharge are available, execute exactly the imported canonical P row and restore one token; otherwise no feasible action
new_field_rules.receiver_content: receiver operation reads the last raw WheelState (p,w) of source history, transfers p through the typed position map and w through the typed phase map, then constructs target-tagged WheelState(p,w); M is computed afterward from target T1 f and L, never consulted by the operation
new_field_rules.route_register: checked route is (dereferenced raw source history state sequence, raw corridor event sequence); at exit copy that tuple to target-owned register, retain it after funded actions; neither route id nor verdict is register content
new_field_rules.c7_joint_pairing: finite pairing distribution from declared coupling edges of two actual history branches; no assertion that T1 P itself forces the edges
new_field_rules.recognition: notAddressed because recognition is outside the structural handoff claim
new_field_rules.c5_protocol_graph: carry POS-03 three-vertex cycle protocol form onto named T1 histories as an independent probe; do not identify its edges with T1 P transitions
new_field_rules.c7_assemblages: on each tag keep two distinct assemblages and complete ordered branch records; each has its own raw coupling; reassembly consistency is checked per assemblage (not an inverse function of coupling alone), so two assemblages may carry identical couplings and equal jointPairing distributions
new_field_rules.route_future_readout: after one funded target step read the phase of the first raw source state retained in the target-owned route tuple; if register absent the output is none; P marginal unchanged
new_field_rules.local_assignments: for every (tag,state,clause) in tags × exact K × {C1,…,C8}, create coordinate tag:state:clause referencing that clause primitive; this is typed raw assignment, never a stored truth value
new_field_rules.staged_clause_map: apply tag swap to each local coordinate and the listed primitive reference; require raw equations on T1 factor, channel, protocol, trace, coupling and ledger separately
new_field_rules.latent_receiver: choose the first state in the published T1 K order as the latent factor state; one-token initial budget and funded receiver follow the one-token action rule
new_field_rules.corridor_support: by event kind: each mix event has both source and target support; exit has target only; strict_step iff listed stage ordinal increases by one; atomic means one listed event per step
new_field_rules.route_path_names: route_a and route_b are external references to first and second representative histories only; checked route equality compares their dereferenced raw history+event tuples, not these labels
new_field_rules.c5_edge_rule: on protocol vertices u,v,w, genuine self and scheduled other each have the three forward cycle edges in their channel; internalized has forward and reverse edges in both channels; null has none, copied in form from POS-03
new_field_rules.positive_raw_inputs: per-tag action distributions are copies of published T1 all-action table; public channel rule is position; each funded state-action tick increment is one; each route has a target-owned record writer; source and target recharge resources are present; receiver activation and content rules are separate raw fields
new_field_rules.mutation_override_semantics: each mutation changes only the JSON Pointer fields in its changes list using replace/add/remove; replace and remove require an existing path, add /- appends to an existing array; all unchanged fields retain their positive raw value
new_field_rules.counterfactual_M_computation: for each tag and raw WheelState z=(p,w), compute f(z)=p; for every T1 action read that tag raw action-distribution support, label each destination safe/lethal by published T1 hazard rule, and form continuation law L(z); M(z)=(f(z),L(z)); never read t1_import.M_class_labels or any stored counterfactual class as the counterfactual result

new_data.source_to_target_state_map: tag swap preserving T1 state label
new_data.source_to_target_history_map: pointwise tag swap; preserve terminal M and path order

future_route_readout.rule: phase of first source WheelState in retained raw route tuple after one funded target step

corridor.route_domain_rule: dereference source_history to raw state sequence and concatenate the raw event sequence; compare these tuples, not route id

maintenance.canonical_transition_table: raw_inputs.by_tag.{tag}.action_distributions at canonical policy; compare with t1_import.P in funded regime

c5.credit_rule: per channel compare forward and reverse cycle multiplicity products; exactly self asymmetric => self, exactly other => other, neither => none, both => ambiguous; owner must agree, internalized judged by products
c5.grade: surrogate; graph is a protocol probe, not the T1 P support

c7.staged_map: tag each history and preserve coupling edges
c7.ambient_coupling_rule: all four slot functions from {0,1} to {0,1}; admissible maps are the two bijections
c7.operational_use: during pre-exit mixed event, receiver reads exact jointPairing distribution to choose a branch-pair display; post-exit P remains unchanged; this is an independent surrogate interface
c7.reassembly_rule: indexed per-assemblage relation: each row names its assemblage and coupling; row coupling must equal that assemblage raw coupling; injectivity across assemblages is not required

predicate_contracts.C1: exact imported T1 factor P, C, U, E2eps and Lean theorem result on both tags
predicate_contracts.C2: D_fact(f,M) nonempty with pinned p1 split on each tag
predicate_contracts.C3: public profile refinement 6→7→7, terminal equality M on each tag
predicate_contracts.C4: surrogate same-current different-M connector and expanded-channel collision loss; full HIDD non-exposure separately checked and expected obstructed
predicate_contracts.C5: surrogate generator attribution self/other/none from declared provenance; no T5 lift
predicate_contracts.C6: surrogate funded event/path arrow with full-signature all-word q sufficiency and strict coarseness
predicate_contracts.C7: surrogate R_rec strictly refines branchwise history quotient by jointPairing and transports through tag map
predicate_contracts.C8: computed greatest funded viable subset of exact K using ledger rule; underfunding recomputed
predicate_contracts.bridge: derive both terminal M classes from raw source/receiver states; raw map preserves support/order/tick/progress/record/owner/route on covered histories
predicate_contracts.corridor: mixed support, strict steps, no gap, source/target intervention dependence
predicate_contracts.handoff: compute receiver raw target state from terminal p,w; then check activation failure, representative independence, content sensitivity, route memory, withdrawal viability, source package, staged clauses, distinct tags, recognition notAddressed
predicate_contracts.content_sensitivity: with fixed latent receiver and unchanged activation, compute each source terminal M from raw state/action support; apply receiver raw p,w operation to obtain target WheelState; compute target M afresh from target raw state/action support; compare both target classes and checked tag-map images
